Name: Dialogue Display Framework Continued (DDFC)
Author: MangusuPixel
Description:
[i]This is an updated version of aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11661]Dialogue Display Framework[/url] to work with the 1.6 updates and continued development. The following description has been updated to reflect changes:

[i]This mod is only available on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]Nexus Mods[/url].﻿ Re-uploads on any other website don't have my permission and likely contain malware and obviously won't be supported.[/i][/i][size=5]

About[/size]

This mod is a modder's resource, it doesn't do anything by itself. It allows multiple creators to simultaneously change individual parts of the display of dialogue boxes while doing so using patches customizable in text format, no code required. More complex mods may also use this framework's API if changes can't be handled by CP.

For examples of mods implementing this framework, see:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]Changing Skies[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23337]Portraited Changing Skies[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11670]Hearts and Gifts Dialogue Display[/url] (works, but uses outdated code)
[*][b]Compatibility patches[/b] in optional files
[/list]
See [url=https://github.com/MangusuPixel/DialogueDisplayFrameworkContinued/blob/main/docs/api.md]mod author documentation[/url] to create your own content packs, complete with examples.
See [url=https://github.com/MangusuPixel/DialogueDisplayFrameworkContinued/blob/main/docs/changelogs.md]changelogs[/url] for version changes.

[size=5]Compatibility Patch[/size]

The compatibility patch under optional files fixes issues until they're fixed in the next stable version of their respective mod.

Currently, it allows support for the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11670]Hearts & Gifts[/url]﻿ - fixes misaligned values and removes the missing ID warning messages
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11670]Hearts & Gifts[/url]﻿ + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]Changing Skies[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23337]Portraited Changing Skies[/url]
[/list]
[size=5]Known ﻿Compatibility[/size]

Compatible with:
[list]
[*]SMAPI for Android. Use the mod configs to make the dialogue box fit your display
[*]Content packs that change ﻿portraits and/or UI assets (recolors)
[*]Mods that add custom NPCs/dialogues, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] should work with portraits of same-size proportions﻿
[*]Animal dialogues made using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14493]MEEP[/url]﻿
[*]Animations made with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]. I was told TextureOverrides works nicely for portraits.
[/list]
Partially compatible with:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] includes a compatibility patch that may work with some success (let me know if it works 100%)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] may be able to animate UI assets and portraits with some oddities.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4668]Platonic Relationships[/url] has some minor display issues with hearts while in the friendzone.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] causes display issues with birthday dialogues.﻿
[/list]
NOT compatible with:[list]
[*]None known so far. Let me know in the comments if you found one.
[/list]
[size=5]﻿Technical[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

The source code, changelogs and releases can also be found on [url=https://github.com/MangusuPixel/DialogueDisplayFrameworkContinued]GitHub[/url].

[size=5]﻿Support & Credits[/size]

If you have issues, suggestions, or feedback, comment here or join my Discord for a quicker response. If you like my mods or a mod you love uses this framework, please consider leaving a donation to show your appreciation while supporting both me and future updates.

Big thanks to:
[list]
[*]aedenthorn for the ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11661]original mod[/url]﻿ version.
[*]Doragoun for helping with the documentation.
[*]MistySpring for the compatibility patch on Farmer's Portrait.
[/list]
